summary: Comprehensive test of Fmail (React Native/Expo + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 30/30 pytest tests passing (100%) covering auth, dashboard, emails/threads/compose, all AI endpoints (understand/thread/reply/ask/email-to-task/file-summary using gpt-5.4 via emergentintegrations), tasks/events/contacts/files/memory/spaces CRUD, meetings (list/get/create/AI notes/ask), agents marketplace+install+toggle+delete, AI representative, search, audit, notifications, followups, Sarvam translate (200 OK with translated_text) and voice transcribe (graceful 502 on synthetic audio). Frontend E2E on mobile viewport (390x844): signup -> Home dashboard with daily brief and seeded counts -> open thread from Needs Action -> Conversation view -> AI Understanding tab returns rich structured JSON (intent, topic, requested action, deadline, key info, questions, people, next action) -> AI Reply writer sheet opens with tones + Generate button -> Ask Fmail tab suggested prompts + free-text question returns real AI answer citing calendar data -> Meet tab lists Fmail Meet with seeded Q4 Planning Review. Bottom tab bar (Home/Mail/Meet/Ask Fmail) navigates correctly via Expo Router links. No red screen errors, no deprecated Expo packages detected, all interactive elements use testID.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1090 lines - consider splitting by resource (auth/mail/ai/meetings/agents) if it grows further; not blocking.
translate() and voice/transcribe() both invoke Sarvam - working; translate succeeded on live test (mayura:v1).
seed_data_creation: Signup auto-seeds a rich dataset (emails, tasks, events, contacts, files, meetings with transcript+notes, memory, spaces, decisions, commitments, followups, installed agents, notifications). Verified via dashboard and each list endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All API routes are under /api. Frontend uses JWT bearer via secure storage key fmail_token. Signup with unique email+username to seed fresh data. LLM calls use gpt-5.4 via emergentintegrations - real calls succeed, first-call latency ~4-8s.
